title: Implement an LRU cache using HashMap and VecDeque in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement an LRU cache with a fixed capacity using HashMap for O(1) lookup and VecDeque to track access order. get() updates recency; put() evicts the least-recently-used entry when at capacity.

required_artifacts: LruCache uses VecDeque to track access order (front=MRU, back=LRU)
get() moves accessed key to front of order
put() evicts the back of order (LRU) when at capacity
put() updates value and recency for existing keys
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
